# Shoppers find products by name

## Description

A shopper types a product's name and reaches its page. It serves the parent initiative's ordering requirement from the finding side.

## Outcome

Shoppers who search reach a product page; the charter's online-orders benefit is the signal.

## Requirements

- R1 (parent R2): A shopper types part of a product's name and reaches that product's page.

## Done when

1. Search runs in production for every shopper.
2. A search for a listed product's full name shows that product first.

## Boundaries

Search by name only. Not filters, not recommendations.
